chunks: Those were the people who were guided by God; so follow their way. Say: 'I ask no recompense of you for this. It is but a reminder for all the people of the world.'

key_terms.أُولَٰئِكَ: Those (referring to a previously mentioned group)

ai.seo_question: Who are the people guided by God that believers are instructed to follow?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited to establish the authority of the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate models of divine guidance, with 'those whom God has guided' often interpreted as including the Prophet, Ali, Fatima, and the Imams. The command to 'follow them' underscores the necessity of emulating their spiritual and moral conduct, while the declaration of seeking no reward highlights the purity of the prophetic mission as a universal reminder (dhikra) for all mankind.
